objective: Determine whether fixed symmetric Boolean triangle circuits replace paired-label correlation association.
source: RS094 pair relation c=sign(N_C)*sign(N_P1) and full RS093 marginal triangle key.

candidateGrid.degreeSubsets: All8 subsets of e1,e2,e3 independently for each encoding/context; 32 candidates.

definitions.bits: For each of3 pairs b=1 iff c=-1 (NEGATIVE) or c=+1 (POSITIVE). A zero correlation yields0 in both encodings.
definitions.circuits: e1=b0 XOR b1 XOR b2; e2=b0*b1 XOR b0*b2 XOR b1*b2; e3=b0*b1*b2, overGF(2).
definitions.triangleFeatures: Always include a constant1 coordinate. For each selected degree include its named E_k coordinate iff e_k=1. MARGINAL additionally includes one coordinate for the sorted triangle of marginal pair keys. No one-hot tuple of circuit values.
definitions.dependencyFeatures: XOR triangle feature vectors over the existing OOO residue.
definitions.control: CSTAR_8 triangle one-hot plus constant; constant is already a projection of one-hot parity and does not change the kernel.

procedure: Test circuit values on all8 bit triples and permutation invariance.
Freeze all33 catalogs, dependency rows, bases and complete kernels; commit before scalar replay.
Replay all fixed scalar characters, verify CIRCUIT_ONLY/MARGINAL empty-degree baselines and paired control.
Report complete grid and all minimal passing degree subsets within each encoding/context; output no fitted coefficient arrays.
guards: Testing factorization through a circuit-feature family does not select or establish a closed scalar combination rule.
Positive and negative encodings are both frozen; no favorable polarity is chosen after replay.
No outcome-picked marginal weights or state exceptions.
No holdout outcomes or scalar labels for synthetic data.
